description: Lignes de tramway en projet is a dataset listed in Open Data Hauts-de-Seine, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Département des Hauts-de-Seine. Tracé des projets de tramway Ce jeu de données présente les tracés des lignes de tramway en projet ainsi que leur année de mise en service. Observations particulières La mise à jour de ce jeu de données est fonction de l'évolution des projets d'infrastructures de transports. Coverage: Hauts-de-Seine. The portal files it under Transport / Mobilité. Its keywords are transports, réseaux, lignes, tramways, projets. The portal shows 9 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2024-01-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-hauts-de-seine-fr-portal.
